away.","source_id":"GLUE_NAV","source_type":"glue","stop_idx":1},{"text":"It's nearly five on a Saturday afternoon, March 25th, 1911, and some six hundred young women are finishing their shift in a garment factory spread across the eighth, ninth, and tenth floors right here — most of them Jewish and Italian immigrants, some as young as thirteen, none older than twenty-three.","source_id":"90e0ec97-d191-45a5-8edb-e2052cae2bb5","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"Just as they're getting ready to leave, a fire springs up in the southeast corner of the eighth floor, and no one has ever worked out how it started.","source_id":"90e0ec97-d191-45a5-8edb-e2052cae2bb5","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"Within minutes all three floors were an inferno — and an inescapable one, because many of the doors had been locked from the outside, to stop theft, the owners said afterward.","source_id":"90e0ec97-d191-45a5-8edb-e2052cae2bb5","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"A fire escape collapsed, and the elevator operator ran.","source_id":"90e0ec97-d191-45a5-8edb-e2052cae2bb5","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"But a man off the street named Joseph Zito rushed in, got the elevator working, and rode it up through the flames five times, hauling out twenty-five to thirty workers on every trip.","source_id":"90e0ec97-d191-45a5-8edb-e2052cae2bb5","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"It still wasn't enough — some women suffocated, some were crushed at the locked doors, and others jumped to their deaths in front of horrified passersby below.","source_id":"90e0ec97-d191-45a5-8edb-e2052cae2bb5","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"In all, 146 people were killed at the Triangle Shirtwaist Factory, most of them in the first ten minutes of a blaze that burned for an hour.","source_id":"90e0ec97-d191-45a5-8edb-e2052cae2bb5","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"This time the city refused to look away, and after wave upon wave of protest the state legislature rewrote its labor code into the most stringent in the nation.","source_id":"d4133d1f-3356-4ae7-8308-0c473474b435","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"The labor movement, struggling until then, gathered steam, and the International Ladies Garment Workers Union — the ILGWU — grew into a real force in the industry.","source_id":"d4133d1f-3356-4ae7-8308-0c473474b435","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1}]}
